name: nds_3d
statement: The DS 3D engine as a game's code sees it while nothing is drawn: the geometry command FIFO (GXFIFO 0x04000400 and the command ports 0x04000440-0x040005FF) takes every command at once, so GXSTAT (0x04000600) always reports the FIFO empty and the engine idle; the FIFO interrupt (GXSTAT bits 30-31) fires while its condition holds, and DMA in geometry-FIFO mode runs at once. No polygons are transformed or drawn yet.

registers.name: GXSTAT
registers.bits: 0 test busy, 1 box test, 8-12 position/vector matrix stack level, 13 projection stack level, 14 matrix stack busy, 15 stack overflow, 16-24 FIFO entries, 25 less than half full, 26 empty, 27 busy, 30-31 FIFO interrupt (1 less than half full, 2 empty)

limits: no geometry, no rasteriser: the 3D layer (BG0 in 3D mode) stays transparent, matrices and test results read as zero
